title: Animals

parent.why: Matching a sound to an animal is listening practice, and children love it — a good starting point.

parent.learn: Animal homes: bird–nest, bee–hive, dog–kennel, lion–den, spider–web.
parent.why: Every animal needs shelter from rain, heat and danger, and builds or finds a home that suits it.

parent.learn: Baby animals: cow–calf, dog–puppy, cat–kitten, hen–chick.
parent.why: Many baby animals have their own names; it shows that animals grow up just like people.
Pets live with us, farm animals give us food or help with work, and wild animals look after themselves in forests and jungles.

ask: What sound does a cow make? A cat? A duck?
What is a baby dog called?
Name an animal that can fly, one that can swim and one that can climb.
Is a tiger a pet or a wild animal?
Which animals have you seen near our home?

rounds.h: Fish live and breathe in water.
Birds build nests of twigs and grass.
Bees live together in a hive.

rounds.t: A pet dog lives in a…
rounds.h: A kennel is a little house for a dog.

rounds.t: A baby cow is called a…
rounds.h: A baby cow is a calf.

rounds.t: A baby dog is called a…
rounds.h: A baby dog is a puppy.

rounds.t: A baby cat is called a…
rounds.h: A baby cat is a kitten.

rounds.t: A baby hen is called a…
rounds.h: A baby hen is a chick.

rounds.t: Which one is a wild animal?
rounds.h: Tigers live in forests and look after themselves; the others live with people.
